text: Figure 9.72: Interfaces of UCM Master Name: VehiclePackageManagement Technology: ara::com service interface Usage: Public API Description: This interface provides functionality for managing and transferring Vehicle Packages and Software Package s to UCM Master . AllowCampaign Allows a new campaign to start. CancelCampaign Aborts an ongoing campaign processing of a Vehicle Package . DeleteT ransfer Delete a transferred Software Package or Vehicle Package . GetCampaignHistory Retrieve all actions that have been performed by UCM Master . Operations: GetSwClusterInfo Get a list of SoftwareClusters that are in state kPresent. ▽
